traceInput: One JSON file containing application: complete original Evidence, seed, optional native_observations and direction. CLI does not accept retained-evidence references.
memoryRequirement: Complete value graph is assembled; validation, authenticated canonical digest and tracing add allocations. Actual heap headroom may reject inputs.
output: --format json or jsonl streams complete results for all ordinary commands. --token-count can materialize formatted text; avoid it and presentation filters for canonical raw Evidence.
evidenceIntegrity: parseEvidence authenticates semantic identifier using raw_result and normalized_result. Cropping or changing Evidence while preserving its ID is invalid.
